title: Verify that an unauthenticated user cannot reach the Object Authoring record for the Proposal for Research page
description: No CMS session. Target: the Object Authoring record for QCTEST-130949-ProposalForResearch at https://qcdev.ihorizons.com/object-authoring.
steps_list: Open a fresh browser context with no authentication state and dismiss the announcement popup if it appears
Navigate directly to the Object Authoring URL for the Proposal for Research page record
Attempt to submit an edit to the hero Page Title field by any means available on the returned page
expected_list: The browser context carries no CMS session cookie
The Liferay sign-in screen or an Access Denied message is returned; no authoring form, no field values and no Publish control are rendered
No edit is accepted and the published public page at /en/our-services/information/proposal-for-research still shows the hero title 'Proposal for Research' unchanged

title: Verify that a Site Content Editor can publish the Proposal for Research page
description: Login as Site Content Editor (test1@xyz.com, resolved via cms_role_credentials('Site Content Editor')). Page record QCTEST-130949-ProposalForResearch currently in Draft.
steps_list: Log in to the Control Panel as the Site Content Editor and dismiss the announcement popup
Open the QCTEST-130949-ProposalForResearch record in Object Authoring
Open /en/our-services/information/proposal-for-research in a fresh logged-out browser context
expected_list: Login succeeds and the Control Panel loads for the Site Content Editor account
The record opens in edit mode with the Publish control enabled
The record status changes to Published and the Liferay generic success toast is displayed
The public page returns HTTP 200 and renders the hero title 'Proposal for Research' with all three sections

title: Verify that a Site Content Editor is denied access to Control Panel user and role administration
description: Login as Site Content Editor (test1@xyz.com). The Editor role grants the content lifecycle only, not user/role administration (A-16).
steps_list: Log in to the Control Panel as the Site Content Editor
Navigate directly to the Control Panel Users and Organizations administration URL
Attempt to open the role assignment screen for any user
expected_list: Login succeeds and content authoring surfaces are reachable
An Access Denied message is returned and no user list is rendered
No role assignment form is reachable and no permission change is committed

title: Verify that a Site Content Author can edit and save the Proposal for Research page as a draft
description: Login as Site Content Author (Test2@xyz.com, resolved via cms_role_credentials('Site Content Author')). Edit target: the Overview info card title, changed from 'Clear research focus' to 'QCTEST-130949 Clear research focus'.
steps_list: Log in to the Control Panel as the Site Content Author and dismiss the announcement popup
Open the QCTEST-130949-ProposalForResearch record in Object Authoring and change the first Overview info card title to 'QCTEST-130949 Clear research focus'
Re-open the record and read the info card title field
expected_list: Login succeeds and the record is editable for the Author account
The field accepts the new value
The record is saved in Draft state and the Liferay generic success toast is displayed
The info card title field reads 'QCTEST-130949 Clear research focus' after re-opening the record

title: Verify that a Site Content Author cannot publish the Proposal for Research page directly
description: Login as Site Content Author (Test2@xyz.com). Record QCTEST-130949-ProposalForResearch is in Draft with an unpublished hero title change.
steps_list: Log in to the Control Panel as the Site Content Author and open the QCTEST-130949-ProposalForResearch record in Object Authoring
Inspect the available lifecycle controls on the record
Attempt to publish the record directly (including by posting the publish action URL if the control is not rendered)
Open /en/our-services/information/proposal-for-research in a fresh logged-out browser context
expected_list: The record opens in edit mode
No enabled Publish control is offered to the Author; only Save as Draft and Submit for Review are available
The publish attempt is rejected with an Access Denied message and the record status stays Draft
The public page still shows the previously published content; the Author's unpublished change is not visible to an anonymous visitor
